reviews.text: BNB is Binance’s exchange token for trading fees and staking. Launched in 2017, BNB Chain grew into an L1 ecosystem. In 2025, token burns continue. Utility is widespread.

BNB is the native coin of the Binance ecosystem. It pays for gas on BNB Smart Chain, now using the opBNB Layer-2 and also in the Greenfield storage network, a Binance decentralized storage solution. Originally launched as a Binance exchange token, it now also grants governance rights and is used in promotional staking programs. Talking about Binance, it is famous for the launchpool where new projects are launched and to be one of the most used CEX in the world (the top one almost everywhere), so influential that most people in crypto projects ask: WEN BINANCE? As it is a very good traction to increment the price. Although some critics say that the listing price is around $1M. Pancake swap, the Binance most famous chain DEX, was where most of the shitcoins were before pump.fun.

It's an open source, community driven Blockchain ecosystem, made up of BNB Beacon , BNB Smart chain (BSC) for smart contracts. It's one of the well known Blockchains associated with Binance, arguably the most popular crypto exchange

The Binance Coin is something I use often for trading and gas on Binance’s chains. In everyday terms, it’s extremely useful it runs Binance’s huge exchange ecosystem and lets people pay fees at a discount. As a coin, it’s very widely held one of the top cryptos by market cap and its chain handles transactions super fast. However, I am aware that it’s quite centralized. Binance the company still controls a lot of it, and regulatory issues around Binance can cause BNB to swing sharply. So I like it for utility, but I remember it’s not as decentralized as others.

BNB started as the native token for the biggest crypto exchange, but today it powers the BNB Chain ecosystem used to pay transaction fees, run smart contracts, and participate in governance on the chain.
